candidate.title: EmbeddingSerializer emits only embeddable_host_ids (no sideloaded embeddable_hosts), breaking client hydration
reports: app/serializers/embeddingserializer.rb:3 — hasmany ... embed: :ids without include: true emits only embeddablehostids and no root embeddablehosts collection, so lookupsubtype finds nothing and the admin list hydrates empty

[bug] embeddingserializer declares hasmany :embeddablehosts with embed: :ids, so the show endpoint emits only embeddablehostids and never side-loads the embeddablehost records the new store.js plural hydration path (lookupsubtype on each id) needs to resolve. get /admin/customize/embedding returns an embedding whose ids cannot be hydrated against the payload root, so store.find('embedding') yields a model with no usable embeddablehosts and the new admin embedding tab renders an empty table regardless of how many hosts exist in the database.

[bug] hasmany :embeddablehosts, serializer: embeddablehostserializer, embed: :ids (without include: true) emits only embeddablehostids and no embeddablehosts collection anywhere in the payload, so the client store receives no host records to hydrate and embedding.embeddablehosts cannot contain records carrying host or category data. on the admin embedding page the store's hydrateembedded resolves each id via lookupsubtype against a root collection that does not exist, yielding bare/undefined entries: the table renders rows with blank host names and no category, edit() seeds the host field and category chooser from undefined, and saving such a row submits a blank categoryid which savehost silently replaces with the uncategorized category.
